{{Quote|Oh! Look, Salina, what an ''exotic'' looking flower!''"<br />"''I've never seen anything like it, princess!|Kneesaa and Salina|<ref name="e11" />}}
'''Salina''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Salina was talking with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] when the princess found an exotic [[Damsel flower|flower]], pointing it out to Salina. However, the [[Flower/Legends|flower]] caused Kintaka to shrink and fall through the cracks in the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|village]] platform, with Salina and other village members watching.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Where did it come from, Chief Chirpa?''"<br />"''I know not! But leave it to my daughter to find a bloom of such ''rare beauty!''<nowiki />|Salina and Chirpa|<ref name="e11" />}}
[[File:SalinaFlower.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Salina and Kintaka discover the flower.]]
Salina was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] member of an [[Bright Tree Village tribe|Ewok tribe]] that lived in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="e11" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which include the events of [[Ewoks (1985) 11|''Ewoks'' 11]], to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Salina was talking with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] when Kintaka discovered a [[damsel flower]] that members of the [[Fleebog]] [[Species/Legends|species]] had left for the princess, hoping to lure her to their home so that she could help them defeat a beast known as the [[ra-lugg]]. Kintaka pointed out the exotic [[Flower/Legends|flower]] to Salina, who had never seen anything like it.<ref name="e11" />

The pair then went off to show the find to the rest of the village, with Salina asking [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]], Kintaka's [[Parent/Legends|father]], of the flower's origin; the chief was unaware yet impressed with his daughter's finding it. However, when the [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] noticed the [[Plant/Legends|plant]], he instructed Kintaka to drop it immediately, but it was too late&mdash;Kintaka began shrinking until she was small enough to fall through the cracks in the village platform with Salina and several other Ewoks watching.<ref name="e11" />

==Personality and traits==
Salina had [[Color/Legends|blue]]-and-brown [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="e11" />

==Equipment==
Salina wore a yellow [[Clothing/Legends|hooded]] [[Cape/Legends|cape]] that had a miniature five-pointed star accessory affixed to the hood's brim.<ref name="e11" />

==Behind the scenes==
Salina appeared in the [[Ewoks (1985) 11|eleventh issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[David Manak]], illustrated by [[Warren Kremer]],<ref name="e11" /> and published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[September 30]], [[1986]].<ref name="marvel age">{{BookCite|title=[[Marvel Age]]|number=Vol. 1 No. 45|publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] Group|date=[[December]] [[1986]]|issn=8750-4367}}</ref>
